source: Footwear registry and recorded-contact authoring. Items declare wear.footstepProfile; runtime selects a profile event on the current surface. Run art/audio/repair_footsteps.py after changing processing or profile volume.
provenanceNote: Nox identifies surfaces and movement, not recorded footwear. These footwear banks are derived treatments of those recordings, not claims of authentic separate barefoot/shoe/boot sessions. Vegetation movement, takeoff sounds and clipped source contacts are excluded. Future items can share profiles or declare additional profile keys.
